name: WBES FaceEmbedding No-Ops Mesh Datasets
description: Mesh-only public release for the WBES FaceEmbedding NeurIPS 2026 submission. The release contains REMESH, a synthetic 3DMM-derived benchmark with 500 subjects and six topology variants per subject, and a FaceVerse cross-topology package with original and remesh_10k variants. The archives contain geometry-only NPZ files and intentionally omit intrinsic operators, checkpoints, and heavy pair-level evaluation dumps.
citeAs: Pampaloni, Lorenzo. WBES FaceEmbedding No-Ops Mesh Datasets. Hugging Face dataset repository, 2026. https://huggingface.co/datasets/Pampaj/wbes-faceembedding-noops
rai:dataLimitations: REMESH is a synthetic 3DMM-derived benchmark for metric meta-evaluation. It is not a real-world 3D face reconstruction dataset and should not be used to train identity recognition, demographic inference, biometric identification, or clinical systems. Claims are limited to controlled topology, sampling, support, and pose perturbations derived from canonical synthetic 3D face shapes.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset inherits the biases and representational limits of the underlying 3D morphable model and the synthetic generation process. It may not reflect the full diversity of real human facial morphology, demographics, acquisition conditions, expressions, or pathological/clinical variation.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains synthetic 3D face meshes generated from a 3D morphable model. It does not contain real identities, real photographs, names, demographic labels, health data, or other directly identifying personal information.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for evaluating 3D face distance metrics, registration pipelines, and ranking-preservation behavior under controlled mesh topology changes. It is suitable for metric meta-evaluation and reproducibility of the reported benchmark. It is not intended for biometric identification, demographic classification, face recognition deployment, clinical diagnosis, or evaluating real-world reconstruction quality without additional validation.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive impacts include more transparent and reproducible evaluation of 3D face metrics and better understanding of failure modes in registration-based evaluation. Potential risks include misuse for biometric or identity-related applications if synthetic benchmark results are overgeneralized to real populations. The dataset is synthetic and released with documentation emphasizing its intended metric-evaluation scope and limitations.
prov:wasDerivedFrom: Synthetic 3D face shapes generated from a 3D morphable model.
prov:wasGeneratedBy: Canonical 3DMM-generated meshes were centered, normalized, cropped using a fixed facial-region mask, and converted into multiple topology variants including original, noisy, remeshed, cropped, downsampled, and upsampled realizations. Ground-truth identity-distance matrices were computed from dense canonical correspondences.

distribution.name: REMESH_npz_data_topo_500_noops.tar.zst
distribution.description: REMESH mesh-only archive with 500 synthetic subjects and six topology variants per subject. NPZ entries contain geometry arrays V and F only.

distribution.name: FaceVerse_cross_topology_10k_noops.tar.zst
distribution.description: FaceVerse cross-topology mesh-only archive with original and remesh_10k variants per subject. NPZ entries contain geometry arrays verts and faces only.
